2608.18182.title: Efficient INT8 Inference of Small NLP Models on Server CPUs with PyTorch Native Stack
2608.18182.paper_summary: Small NLP models, especially BERT-family encoders, remain important in industrial workloads such as classification, ranking, and retrieval even in the era of large language models. On server CPUs, INT8 quantization offers an attractive latency-throughput-cost trade-off, but users increasingly expect such acceleration to be available directly in the native PyTorch stack. We integrate SmoothQuant into TorchAO and optimize the resulting inference path for Intel Xeon CPUs through graph-level fusion in TorchInductor and efficient INT8 GEMM kernel selection across oneDNN-, AVX512_VNNI-, and AMX-based implementations. Across BERT, DistilBERT, and XLM-RoBERTa benchmarks, the approach delivers up to 5.8x end-to-end throughput speedup with negligible---and in some cases no measurable---accuracy loss relative to the FP32 baseline. We also validated our work by detailed performance analysis with roofline models. The implementation has been upstreamed to PyTorch and TorchAO, enabling out-of-the-box deployment with native PyTorch tooling
2608.18182.paper_summary_zh: 小型 NLP 模型，特別是 BERT 系列編碼器，在大型語言模型時代仍然在分類、排名和檢索等工業工作負載中扮演重要角色。在伺服器 CPU 上，INT8 量化提供了一個有吸引力的延遲-吞吐量-成本權衡，但用戶越來越期望這種加速能夠直接在原生 PyTorch 堆疊中可用。我們將 SmoothQuant 整合到 TorchAO 中，並通過在 TorchInductor 中的圖形級融合以及在 oneDNN、AVX512_VNNI 和 AMX 基礎實現之間高效選擇 INT8 GEMM 核心來優化結果推理路徑。在 BERT、DistilBERT 和 XLM-RoBERTa 基準測試中，該方法提供了高達 5.8 倍的端到端吞吐量加速，與 FP32 基準相比，準確性損失微乎其微——在某些情況下甚至沒有可測量的損失。我們還通過詳細的性能分析和屋頂線模型驗證了我們的工作。該實現已上游至 PyTorch 和 TorchAO，實現了與原生 PyTorch 工具的即時部署。
